mapping.summary: Gulf of Mexico OCS well points with status and type but no field recording hydrocarbon tests or shows. Each status maps to a well symbol with oil and gas set to 0, and drilling and permit statuses map to their own planned or drilling codes.

rules.note: Permanently abandoned maps to plugged and abandoned, no hydrocarbons recorded
Application for permit to drill: location proposed
Approved sidetrack is planned; closest symbol is location proposed
Temporarily abandoned mapped to suspended; closest match
Drilling suspended mapped to suspended well
Borehole completed; treated as active well, production not recorded

caveats: The layer holds no test results or show fields, so oil and gas are set to 0 for every well; no hydrocarbon content is implied.
COM (Borehole Completed) does not say whether a well produces; it is mapped to an active well symbol with low confidence.
TA and DSI are mapped to suspended wells, and AST to location proposed, as the nearest available SSL symbols.
WELL_NAME has too many distinct values to map on and is not used.
